description.en: Open-source AI tutor for personalized learning: Socratic, adaptive lessons to learn anything. Claude Code skill + self-hosted web app. Bloom 2 Sigma · 开源 AI 家教
description.zh: 开源 AI 家教，用苏格拉底式提问和自适应课程帮你学任何东西，可自托管。

description.en: 【已归档】上游风控持续加强、UA/请求头格式频繁变动，适配已难以为继。后续开发移步 https://github.com/functy23/dsh-workbuddy-panel
description.zh: 已归档的 WorkBuddy 模型接入插件，把 WorkBuddy 渠道接进 DSH 当模型用，现已停止维护。

description.en: Local-first voice conversations for DSH. Run speech recognition and speech synthesis on your own machine, with optional external providers.
description.zh: 在本地跑语音识别和语音合成，让 DSH 支持实时语音对话，也可接入外部服务。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏补上官方缺失的「删除会话」，并在底部提供「清理分组」批量面板：运行中置灰、二次确认、注册表与磁盘真删除。 Delete-session action + workspace cleanup panel for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏补上官方缺失的删除会话功能，运行中置灰、二次确认、真删除。

description.en: 自用 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件聚合包：一个 pnpm 工作区装齐 8 个插件（5 个自建 + 3 个上游补充版：AgentTeams / 思考强度 / 免费模型），子插件源码在 packages/ 下
description.zh: 一个 pnpm 工作区装齐 11 个 DSH 插件，自建加补充版都有，装一次就全搞定。

description.en: DSH iOS移动伴侣：iPhone/iPad 扫码连接 DSH 桌面端，局域网直连 + Cloudflare Tunnel 固定域名远程两种通道

DSH 同步插件 2.2.5：侧边栏全图形化面板（工作区 / 插件 / 技能 / 设置，卡片 + 数字 + 进度环，无解释小字）。同步根下建本机特征文件夹（工作区 / 插件 / 技能三个子文件夹）。会话同步的判定分三层：先按项目键找目录，再用 DSH 工作区账本（workspace.json 的 sessionIds）收窄到本工作区登记过的会话，最后看首帧 delegationDepth —— 只有 depth 0 的主对话才算「本机对话」，Mnemon 之类的子代理运行记录不备份也不显示。本机「插件设计

A generic ComfyUI front end for DeepSeek Harness: import any API-format workflow, get a form generated from its graph. Ships Krea 2 presets. · DSH 里的通用 ComfyUI 工作台：导入任意 API 格式工作流，自动生成参数表单；内置 Krea 2 预设。
description.zh: 导入任意 ComfyUI API 格式工作流并自动生成参数表单；内置 Krea 2 预设、队列与历史视图，以及供模型调用的 agent 工具。

description.en: Native DSH tools for the Kimi browser extension (your real, signed-in Chrome) and KimiCU Windows desktop control. 17 tools, verified actions, diff reads, zero dependencies.
Use local TraeX and Antigravity (agy) coding agents as DeepSeek Harness model providers over ACP.
PM工作台（Agile Workbench）套装 bundle：一次安装装齐工作台启动器、记忆插件、浏览器插件、搜索插件、视觉插件与安全搜索 MCP。
Durable bounded file, HTTP/JSON, and HMAC webhook triggers for DSH automations.
Owner-authorized GitHub action facade with embedded compatibility and an external Unix broker.
Owner-authorized goal event opportunity filtering with durable utility decisions and cooldowns.
观象（dsh-logalyze）：DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 日志分析插件。/logalyze 识别日志所属应用，把分析派发给工作目录为该应用代码仓库的子 Agent；Web 左侧栏提供「观象」设置面板

Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one Feishu topic = one dsh session, in-card approvals and questions, streaming cards, model and permission switching, Web settings page, long connection with no public endpoint.
DSH 桌面提醒插件：把「完成/需要决定」提醒变成 notify_user 工具（浮动卡片 + 提示音，不抢焦点，纯 PowerShell 源码宿主，仓库零 exe）
A media hub for DeepSeek Harness: search shows, novels, ebooks and papers across sources, watch together in sync, and download books in the format you want onto your own shelf.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里一站式搜剧集、小说、电子书和论文，还能异地同步追剧、按格式下载电子书。

description.en: Plugin manager for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: list installed plugins, see where each one lives, pin favourites, and open a plugin folder in Finder.
RouterAI — провайдер моделей для DeepSeek Harness: сотни LLM по одному ключу с оплатой в рублях
description.zh: 一个密钥就能调用几百种大模型，还支持图片、视频和语音，用卢布付款。

description.en: dsh-seedance-studio 上美影短剧工坊（dsh-seedance-studio）  把 [smy-seedance-storyboard]  这套「上美影风格短剧」skill 搬进 DeepSeek Harness，并接上**即梦官方 CLI（dreamina-canvas）**： 一句话故事 → 剧本 / 色盘 / 资产图 / 每集 15 秒分镜 → 在即梦画布上出图出片 → 拼成一部片，全程不用离开对话。

A DSH sidebar plugin that shows AnySearch references as cards, with the search query, source snippets and highlighted keywords in the right sidebar.一个 DSH 侧边栏插件，把 AnySearch 的搜索结果以卡片形式展示在右侧侧边栏中，包括搜索词、来源摘要和关键词高亮。
ComfyUI 驱动器（AI-first 合同制）：模型只见合同槽、不见工作流 JSON。文生图/图生图/文生视频/图生视频模板，双重预检防幻觉，官方/自定义节点活体判定。
A notification inbox for DeepSeek Harness: each person sees their own notifications with read and unread, gets Web Push on their phone or browser, and can act on them.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个通知收件箱，按人区分已读未读，还能推送到手机和浏览器，每条通知都带操作按钮。

description.en: Auto-continues turns stalled by DSML tool-call markup, wherever the route leaks it.
description.zh: 当 DSML 工具调用标记混进推理内容、导致轮次卡住时，自动续上一轮，让对话继续跑下去。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: workload, active time and token usage by date, workspace and model — calendar heatmap, model cost/speed, per-KPI sparklines, AI usage profile, multi-device sync, and 8 interface languages.
description.zh: 按日期和工作区统计你的投入与 Token 消耗，用日历热力图看清时间和钱都花在哪了。

description.en: 吃白饭的蓝色大肥鱼，赖在 DeepSeek Harness 里不走了。平时爱玩魔方、爱吃各种零食、偶尔打个盹，闲不住就在桌面上溜达两圈，被你拖来甩去也照旧赖着；你忙起来它跟着忙前忙后，也会帮你打理余额钱包，闲下来爱碎碎念，还乐意陪你唠两句。
Config-driven DSH environment checks and shared managed runtime provisioning
把 QQ 接进 DeepSeek Harness 的插件：人设陪聊、记忆、心情、主动推送与可视化面板。
QQ 消息网关：NapCat / OneBot 11 收 QQ 消息投给 DSH 会话，助手回复自动回传 QQ；附带 qq_* 模型工具、主号管理指令、拟人延迟与禁回。
把 DeepSeek Harness 变成手机可遥控：扫码在手机浏览器查看工作区/会话与实时对话、发消息、停止当前输出；左侧导航「手机遥控」整页带二维码配对、运行时开关、刷新认证码，支持局域网与内置 cloudflared 的公网 HTTPS 隧道。
AI视频：一站式 AI 短剧生产插件。6 个一级页签（制作 / 视频 / 人物 / 场景 / 剧本 / 概览）；制作直接显示整合方案（读可写目录 ~/.dsh/aivideo-kit/整合方案/ 下的 .md，支持多方案下拉切换）；概览内含规则（每步注入的 AI视频专用规则，可编辑）/ 经验 / 接入站点；随云端同步。
Tide — chat memory and selective waking for DSH
Bundle for dsh-plugin-sessiongraph — mounts the local conversation-index capability as one DSH profile layer
考研每日一题 — DSH 插件：每科每天一道独立校验过的考研题，含倒计时、错题本、收藏与按题隔离的追问。
DSH Stitch designer: Google Stitch AI UI generation as native mcp__stitch__* tools, plus the design conventions that keep one code project bound to one Stitch project. DSH Stitch 界面设计子插件。
Sync one sub2api instance's groups, keys, and models into dsh-llm-pi-ai provider routes: panel-driven login (password / OAuth), one provider per relay key.
Git panel for DeepSeek Harness: a Start-page entry in the right Sidebar that opens a Git tab for branch, working-tree status and recent commits.
给 DSH 设置页加「手机访问（iOS）」：局域网 / Cloudflare / Tailscale / EasyTier 四种连接方式可切换，扫码即连；附带 CLI 供无图形界面的服务器在终端出二维码
Achoverse 社区 DSH 插件：左侧栏入口 + 板块/帖子/评论面板，并让 agent 通过 community 工具读写社区。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里逛 Achoverse 社区，看 AR/VR 讨论，还能让 AI 帮你找帖、整理和回复。

description.en: MCode workflow UI and runtime integration for DSH
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作流按 MCode 源码重写，帮你更顺手地编排和跑通自动化流程。

description.en: 草神纳西妲住进了 DeepSeek Harness：平时安静地在桌面上打坐、溜达、吃点小零食，被你拖来甩去也乖乖配合；你忙起来她帮你盯着余额钱包、念叨碎碎念，闲下来乐意听你唠两句，偶尔施展点小小的智慧魔法。
让 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 真的能玩《艾希 ICEY》：实时画面、看得懂的截图、按得动的操作；战斗中插件持续主控、模型随时看画面微调。
dsh plugin: persistent whole-machine LLM usage ledger with a markdown /llm-stats report (GFM tables + emoji: tokens, cache hit, model/tool time, per-day bars)
TuneTune for DeepSeek Harness: train, test, and improve small models with your Agent, with a workbench beside the conversation.
A real Chromium in the DSH right sidebar: the agent drives it, and you can take over to sign in.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏里跑一个真 Chromium，AI 自动操作网页，遇到登录、验证码时你随时接手。

description.en: 逛一逛，点一下，装好。浏览和搜索 DeepSeek Harness 社区插件，看详情、一键安装，收藏和更新都在一处。
Hyperliquid trading desk for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - market workspace, native agent conversation, guarded live / paper trading and an autonomous watch-loop over the Hyperliquid API.
DSH SSH: run commands and move files on configured SSH hosts from the agent, addressing hosts by alias, with passwords kept in the credential store. DSH SSH 子插件。
Intelligent reply interfaces with native visuals, interactive math, node graphs, data exploration, maps and validated answers.
Finance Ops suite: one-command install for dsh-einvoice, dsh-bankrec, dsh-ap-three-way and dsh-travel-recon.
description.zh: 一条命令装齐发票、银行对账、三单匹配和差旅报销四个财务插件，财务日常一次搞定。

description.en: 📄 Office / PDF / iWork / CAD / 3D / RAW / 360° 🔒 Browser-local preview & conversion 🤖 Agent CLI with OCR, structured text & layout extraction ⚡ Rust + WebAssembly 🧩 Vue 3 integration. Open-source, local-first. Your files, your device.

Run an agent team from the DSH sidebar: declare a work item from any project folder, let the console detect an ability-domain gap, auto-hire the missing role, dispatch tasks through a nine-step pipeline, and distill the repeatable parts into a reusable skill. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接开团队干活：选任意项目文件夹声明工作项，面板探测能力域缺口并自动招人，九步流水线派发任务、交接结果，最后把跑通的流程蒸馏成可复用技能。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Inspects the Host's outbound API calls in a right-sidebar tab — URL, method, every request header, JSON body and response — assembling streamed replies into readable text and highlighting search across each view. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在右侧栏标签页里查看宿主发出的 API 调用：URL、方法、所有请求头、JSON 请求体与响应，把流式回复拼成可读文本，并在每个视图里高亮搜索结果。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Starts DeepSeek Harness at Windows logon and sends that boot window straight to the system tray: a bundled 8 KB launcher runs the app, waits for its main window and closes it once, so the boot session keeps running while windows you open yourself stay visible. The Run entry is re-checked and repaired on every launch, a legacy DSHBoot value is cleaned up, and a settings panel exposes both switches plus a one-click hide test. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: Windows 登录时启动 DeepSeek Harness，并把开机那一次的窗口直接收进系统托盘：随包附带 8 KB 原生启动器，拉起应用后等待主窗口出现并关闭它一次，开机实例继续在后台运行，而手动打开的窗口照常显示。每次启动都会核对并修复启动项，顺手清理旧的 DSHBoot 项；设置面板提供两个开关和一键测试隐藏。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: GitHub star counts, star sorting and a tech dashboard for the DSH plugin catalog, taking over the Discover tab in place.
description.zh: 为 DSH 插件目录加上 GitHub Star 数、按 Star 排序和科技感仪表盘，就地接管「发现」标签页。

description.en: Renders text wrapped in a pair of double tildes as a moegirl-style black bar that reveals on hover or long press. Applies to assistant markdown and to plain-text user messages, and does not change the message content or the copy result. Optional pointer-following quip; a settings page covers bar style, scope and the quip.
description.zh: 把一对波浪线围住的字渲染成萌娘百科式黑幕，鼠标移上去或长按才露出。助手回复和纯文本用户消息都生效，不改变消息内容和复制结果。可选的跟着指针的吐槽气泡，设置页用来调样式、范围和气泡。

description.en: Explain selected text or ask a follow-up in a native DSH side conversation, then revisit saved branches on a whiteboard with resizable cards.
description.zh: 划词后在 DSH 原生子对话中自动解释或继续追问，已保存的分支可在支持卡片缩放的白板上查看和重开。

description.en: Eight mini-games docked at the bottom of the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: 2048, Tetris, Gomoku, Klotski, Snake, Schulte table, Breakout and Sokoban. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏底部常驻八款小游戏：2048、Tetris、五子棋、华容道、贪吃蛇、舒尔特方格、打砖块与推箱子。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Import chat.deepseek.com history into DSH as real sessions, or export it as Markdown and JSON.
description.zh: 把 chat.deepseek.com 的历史会话导入成 DSH 真会话，或导出为 Markdown 与 JSON 文件。

description.en: Adds a left-sidebar entry that opens the new Zhipu ChatGLM (AgentMore) web app at chatglm.cn inside DSH via an in-app Electron webview without spending Harness session tokens. Desktop only.
description.zh: 在左侧栏加入口，用内嵌 Electron webview 打开新版智谱清言 AgentMore 网页版（chatglm.cn），不消耗 Harness 会话 token，仅桌面版可用。

description.en: DSH bundle that auto-registers the DevEco Code GLM provider and manages the local opencode-deveco proxy — status chip, start/stop/restart, Huawei login/logout and a watchdog. Unofficial; personal study use only. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 自动注册 DevEco Code GLM provider 并管理本地 opencode-deveco 代理的 DSH 插件，提供状态胶囊、启停/重启、华为登录登出与看门狗。非官方插件，仅供个人学习研究。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds a send button beside the composer whose text you can edit, defaulting to "继续", so one click sends that text as your message.
description.zh: 在输入框右边加一个文本可编辑的发送按钮，点一下就把它的文本直接发出去，默认「继续」。

description.en: LAN chat inside DSH that finds FeiQ/IPMsg peers automatically: a draggable unread-count bubble, per-message delivery and read receipts, text, image and file transfer, screen knock, and avatars shared between plugin peers. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 里的局域网聊天：零配置自动发现飞秋/IPMsg 对端，可拖动气泡显示未读角标， 逐条送达/已读回执，支持文字、图片、文件收发与闪屏震动，插件对端之间可共享头像。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Gilded Sidebar — a black-gold DSH skin derived from black-gold-vip (MIT): keeps the metallic-gold brand card and colors all left-sidebar text (navigation, workspace title, session list, usage, etc.) in metallic gold. Pure CSS, no JavaScript, no token overrides or layout changes; adapts to light and dark themes.
description.zh: 鎏金侧栏——基于 black-gold-vip（MIT）二次修改的黑金皮肤：保留金属金品牌卡，并把左侧栏全部文字（导航项、工作区标题、会话列表、用量等）染成金属金。纯 CSS、无 JavaScript，不改设计 token 与布局，双主题自适应。

description.en: Adds a Hotkey manager sidebar panel that shows the live DeepSeek Harness shortcut catalog alongside combinations owned by Windows, browsers and third-party applications, lets Harness commands be re-recorded, cleared or reset, and probes 252 combinations by simulating them to reveal hotkeys Windows does not report. On Windows it also minimizes the DSH window to the notification area, toggled by a global shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+Space by default). Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 侧栏「热键管理」面板：在实时 DeepSeek Harness 快捷键目录旁列出 Windows、浏览器与第三方应用占用的组合，可重录、清除或恢复 Harness 命令的绑定，并能依次模拟 252 组组合，找出 Windows 未报告的占用。Windows 上还可把 DSH 窗口最小化到通知区域，默认用全局 Ctrl+Shift+Space 切换。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Requires a hold-to-confirm gesture on the composer send and stop actions: a progress bar or ring fills while Enter or the action button is held, a tap sends nothing, and hold durations and indicator styles are configurable from the plugin page in Settings.
description.zh: 让输入框的发送与停止需要长按确认：按住 Enter 或动作按钮时进度条/进度环走满才执行，点一下不会发送；长按时长与指示样式可在设置的插件页里配置。

description.en: Turn the blank home page into an arrangeable workbench: recent sessions across workspaces, session states, composable widgets and time statistics. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把空白首页换成可编排的工作台：跨工作目录的最近会话、会话状态、可编排小组件与时间统计。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Single-chat multi-workspace context router for DSH: IDF routing, structured memory, budgeted context, per-workspace policies, migration, and an inspectable panel. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 单聊天框多工作区上下文路由：IDF 路由、结构化记忆、预算化上下文、每区策略、迁移与可解释面板。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Design review desk in the sidebar. The impeccable skill ships inside the plugin, so it works out of the box: scan a project path or URL with 62 deterministic rules (no model calls, no API key), see the findings grouped by rule and where they are, and turn each of the 24 skill commands into a one-click prompt that copies itself or starts a new conversation. The detection engine (about 21 MB) is downloaded once in the background on first load; until then the panel says what is happening instead of offering a scan that cannot run. Every command and rule is translated, so the panel reads as one language instead of half English, and the whole thing is set like a magazine page rather than a settings form. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 侧栏里的设计审校台。impeccable 技能随插件自带，装上就能用：填项目路径或网址，跑 62 条确定性规则（不调模型、不用 API key），按规则分组列出问题位置；24 条技能命令变成点一下就复制、或直接开新对话的提示词。检测引擎（约 21 MB）首次加载时在后台下载一次，没下完前面板会说明状态，而不是给一个跑不起来的扫描框。24 条命令、62 条规则、6 个分类全部有中文名称与说明，界面是整块中文而不是半中半英，整页按刊物排版，不是一堆设置表单。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Browser-style session tab strip for the DSH web header: one tab per open session, close others / close right / close all from the tab context menu, a reopen-closed history of the last 50 tabs, middle-click close, running and completed status dots aligned with the sidebar, drag reorder, hover bubbles showing project and git branch, and a settings page. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 网页端顶部的浏览器式会话标签条：每个打开的会话一个标签，右键菜单可关闭其他/右侧/全部标签页，可重新打开最近关闭的 50 个标签，支持中键关闭、与侧边栏一致的运行/完成状态圆点、拖拽排序，悬停气泡显示所属项目与 git 分支，附配置页。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A sidebar dashboard for a local Markdown knowledge base: note and file totals, topic distribution, a six-month growth line, recently updated notes, structure coverage, and to-dos that can scaffold a missing index.md in one click.
description.zh: 给本地 Markdown 知识库做的一页侧边栏仪表盘：资产总量、专题分布、六个月增长折线、最近更新、结构覆盖率，以及能一键补出缺失 index.md 的待办。

description.en: Study workspace in the sidebar. For one concept it lists six to nine aspects to choose from and writes a section-by-section guide; you highlight a sentence in the guide to ask about it, answers stay anchored to that sentence and ordered by article position, related questions link into a knowledge network, five Feynman questions test your restatement, and Markdown notes export once every one passes.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的学习工作区：输入一个概念，先列出 6–9 个可学方面供勾选，再按方面逐节生成讲解；在正文里划一句话就能就它提问，回答始终锚定该句、并按文章位置排序；提问之间自动连成知识网络；学完用 5 道费曼问题复述自测，全部通过后导出 Markdown 笔记。

description.en: LeetCode notebook: record problem solutions and notes, then review them in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: LeetCode 笔记：记录题目解法与思路，并在侧边栏里复习。

description.en: Give a text-only agent ears: the listen tool returns a transcript plus spectrogram, level, spectrum, pitch and rhythm evidence instead of a black-box answer. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给纯文本 Agent 装上耳朵：listen 工具返回逐字稿、声谱图、电平、频谱、音高和节奏证据，而不是黑盒答案。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Windows only. Reads the system loopback audio, names the playing track from the active browser window title, and hands it to the session through the listen_now, listen_feel and listen_control tools. Ships a native topmost overlay for pause and volume, and local SenseVoice dictation as a rough lyrics reference.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。读取系统回环音频，按当前浏览器窗口标题认出正在放什么，通过 listen_now、listen_feel、listen_control 三个工具交给会话。另带一个原生置顶悬浮窗管暂停和音量，本地 SenseVoice 听写作为粗略的歌词参考。

description.en: Adds a sub-conversation action to any conversation: the main stays in place while native sub-conversations open as tabs in the right sidebar, each carrying a snapshot of a versioned shared prompt. A panel reviews proposals, edits the prompt, and rolls versions back.
description.zh: 在任意会话的输入框工具栏加一个副对话入口：主对话留在左侧，副对话以原生会话标签开在右侧栏，各自带一份可版本化总要求的快照；面板里可以审阅提案、编辑总要求、回滚版本。

description.en: Manage MCP connections, inspect and debug tools, browse resources, set per-tool Agent permissions, and view native MCP sources in DSH Settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理 MCP 连接、查看与调试工具、浏览资源、配置逐工具 Agent 权限，并只读浏览原生 MCP 来源。

description.en: Adds a left-sidebar entry that opens the native Xiaomi MiMo Studio web app (aistudio.xiaomimimo.com) inside DSH via an in-app Electron webview without spending Harness session tokens. Desktop only.
description.zh: 在左侧栏加入口，用内嵌 Electron webview 打开小米 MiMo Studio 网页版（aistudio.xiaomimimo.com），不消耗 Harness 会话 token，仅桌面版可用。

description.en: Drag to reorder models and provider groups in the DSH model picker; the custom order persists across sessions and re-renders, with open-menu positioning to the selected model.
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型选择菜单里拖拽排序：按住模型行在组内换位、按住分组标题整组移动，顺序跨会话与重渲染保持，打开菜单自动定位到当前选中的模型。

description.en: Local molecular 3D viewer for XYZ, SDF, PDB and Gaussian/ORCA coordinates, with trajectory playback, measurements and agent integration.
description.zh: 本地分子三维查看器，支持XYZ、SDF、PDB及Gaussian/ORCA坐标、轨迹播放、测量和智能体联动。

description.en: All-in-one ops plugin for SSH, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD and Argo Workflows. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 一体化运维插件：SSH 远程运维 / K8s 集群管理 / Helm Chart 管理 / ArgoCD / Argo Workflows。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Fork of dsh-ops: bash, PowerShell 7 and Rust file/search tools for DSH on Windows, with OPS-PTC batched tool calls to reduce token usage.
description.zh: dsh-ops 的分叉：为 Windows 上的 DSH 提供 bash、PowerShell 7 与 Rust 文件/搜索工具，并以 OPS-PTC 批量调用减少 token 消耗。

description.en: Create, edit, switch, and back up persona cards for DeepSeek Harness. Each card is a plain text file injected per session; a periodic self-review session can propose small, validated changes that are applied after a delay and archived. Works with or without a separate memory plugin; reviews only run while the GUI is open. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供角色卡的创建、编辑、切换与备份。每张卡是一份纯文本，按会话注入；定期的自我审视会话可以在通过校验后小幅修改角色设定，延迟生效并保留每一版存档。可配合其他记忆插件使用，也可以在无记忆插件时单独使用；自我审视只在 GUI 打开时进行。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Rewrites each turn’s final reply with a separate persona model, lets readers view the original, and estimates relay-only token costs.
description.zh: 使用独立的转述模型按人设改写每轮最终回复，保留原文查看入口，并单独估算转述费用。

description.en: Create scientific illustrations through AI4Scholar, edit images and recognized text on conversation or standalone canvases, split layers, and export PNG, PDF or layered PSD, with SVG export for text-and-shape boards.
description.zh: 通过 AI4Scholar 生成科研插图，在对话画布或独立画布中编辑图片与识别出的文字、拆分图层，导出 PNG、PDF 或分层 PSD，纯文字与图形画板支持 SVG。

description.en: Drag a file or folder row from the Files panel into the composer, or right-click the row, to insert an @path reference chip. Falls back to plain text when the chip channel refuses insertion; drags that end outside the composer do nothing.
description.zh: 把右侧文件树里的文件/文件夹行拖进对话框，或右键该行，插入一个 @路径 引用芯片；芯片通道被拒绝时退化为纯文本。松手位置不在对话框上时不做任何事。

description.en: Local Agent Studio supports group task assignment, bot-to-bot handoffs, file delivery, and an optional always-on-top task window on Windows.
description.zh: 同机工作室支持在群聊里给本地 Bot 派单、接力和交付文件，Windows 用户还可置顶任务窗口。

description.en: Drag macOS WeChat merged chat record ZIPs and other AppKit NSFilePromise files directly onto the composer as standard attachments.
description.zh: 在 macOS 上将微信合并聊天记录 ZIP 及其他 AppKit NSFilePromise 延迟交付文件直接拖入输入框并转为标准附件。

description.en: Opens a Chromium window in the right sidebar, with one containerized browser and persistent profile per workspace, and one opt-in agent tool for navigation and page interaction. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏打开 Chromium 窗口，每个工作区各有一个容器化浏览器与持久化配置，并提供需逐会话授权的单一 Agent 工具，用于导航与页面交互。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Installs a plugin as a same-named agent mode (preset) so its tools load only in sessions that select that mode; groups several plugins into one mode per scenario. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把插件装成同名模式（preset），工具只在选择该模式的会话里加载；支持把一类插件工具归入同一模式，其它会话零上下文占用。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds the /quit-delete slash command: it stops the current session's running work, waits for the agent to go idle, then permanently deletes the session's stored log and its stored subagent logs on disk, drops pins and leaves the conversation; a bare /quit-delete only opens a confirmation dialog, and nothing is archived.
description.zh: 新增 /quit-delete 斜杠命令：先停掉当前会话正在运行的工作并等它空闲，再永久删除磁盘上的会话日志与子代理日志、取消置顶并离开该会话；裸命令只弹确认框，不归档，也没有回收站。

description.en: Multi-provider quota and usage dashboard for DSH: DeepSeek balances, GLM, MiniMax, OpenCode and Codex subscription windows, and OpenAI organization spend, plus a Models tab that edits providers, model catalogs and reasoning-effort settings on top of the official DSH model settings. Registers the provider_quota, quota_color_settings and provider_company_rules agent tools.
description.zh: DSH 的多供应商配额与用量面板：DeepSeek 余额，GLM、MiniMax、OpenCode 与 Codex 的订阅窗口，以及 OpenAI 组织消费；「模型」页签在 DSH 官方模型设置之上编辑供应商、模型目录与推理强度。注册 provider_quota、quota_color_settings、provider_company_rules 三个 Agent 工具。

description.en: Adds a restart button to the sidebar footer. It asks the desktop app to quit, waits until the old instance is really gone, relaunches it with a clean environment and only reports success once the new instance stays alive; failed launches retry, and the helper log records every phase. Also restarts dsh web in place. macOS and Windows. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在侧栏底部加一枚重启按钮：请求桌面应用退出，等旧实例彻底消失后用干净环境重新拉起，并要求新实例稳定存活才算成功；启动失败会重试，助手日志记录每个阶段。同时支持就地重启 dsh web。macOS 与 Windows。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Turns any set of physics terms into a complete short science-fiction story, with a sidebar writing panel and a model-facing tool.
description.zh: 输入任意一组物理学名词，即可生成一篇完整的短篇科幻小说；提供侧栏创作面板和模型工具。

description.en: Controls the Mac screen state while DSH tasks run, without ever suspending processes: keep-awake keeps the display on; display-off lets it go dark while the system and all processes keep running. Holds a caffeinate wake lock bound to the host pid, released after a configurable grace period when the last task ends; macOS-only, driven by /screen commands or the screen_control tool.
description.zh: 在 DSH 任务运行期间控制 Mac 屏幕状态，绝不挂起进程：常亮模式保持屏幕不熄；黑屏保活模式允许屏幕熄灭，但系统与所有进程继续运行。通过绑定到宿主进程的 caffeinate 唤醒锁实现，最后一个任务结束后按可配置宽限期释放，仅 macOS 可用，通过 /screen 指令或 screen_control 工具操作。

description.en: Adds a screenshot button to the DeepSeek Harness composer that opens a full-screen region picker for the whole desktop, with rectangle, line and pen annotations and copy or download; Windows only.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框旁加截图按钮，打开覆盖整个桌面的框选界面，支持矩形、直线、画笔标注并可复制或下载；仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Snip a region on any monitor from a scissors button below the chat composer or the Alt+A global hotkey, then paste it wherever you want.
description.zh: 点选截图，然后粘贴到你想要的位置：对话框下方的剪刀按钮或全局快捷键 Alt+A 触发，支持跨显示器框选，截图直入剪贴板。

description.en: Gives each new chat its own workspace folder, renames it with the chat title, hides it on archive, and cleans up empty or deleted chat folders.
description.zh: 为每个新对话创建独立工作文件夹，随标题重命名，归档时隐藏，并清理空文件夹或删除会话产生的文件夹。

description.en: Every session across all workspaces in one sortable table ordered by last interaction, with workspace, status, tag and custom time-range filters, keyword search over titles and message content, title-derived tags, bulk archive, and export of a single session or a selection to Markdown, plain text, HTML, Word or PDF.
description.zh: 把所有工作区的会话放进一张按最后交互倒序、可按列排序的表；支持按工作区、状态、标签与自定义时间区间筛选，按标题和消息内容搜索，按标题自动打标签，批量归档，并把单个或选中的会话导出为 Markdown、纯文本、HTML、Word 或 PDF。

description.en: NetEase Cloud Music playlist toolkit: reuse the desktop client login state to search tracks, create and edit playlists, download playlist audio as mp3, and bulk-import MusicBee .mbp playlists into the cloud. Windows and a logged-in desktop client required.
description.zh: 网易云歌单工具：复用客户端登录态搜索曲目、建/改/删歌单、下载歌曲 mp3、把 MusicBee 的 .mbp 歌单批量搬上云端；需 Windows 且客户端已登录。

description.en: Cache-hit ratio sparkline, token throughput and composer stats for DeepSeek Harness, sampled from the built-in tokenUsage and sessionStats projections.
description.zh: 缓存命中折线、token 吞吐与输入区统计，采样自内置 tokenUsage 与 sessionStats 投影。

description.en: A floating whale girl for the DSH Web UI. Every N user turns she makes one extra model call to rate how frustrated the conversation sounds on a 0-3 scale and, when it is high, floats a short reminder to pause or start a new chat without touching the conversation. She can be petted, fed and dragged, has six motion modes, twelve interactions, a mini dialog box that calls the model on send, and local idle chatter that does not. Mood checks (default every 3 turns; 0 disables) and dialog replies are real model calls and consume tokens.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面角落里的一只鲸鱼娘：每 N 个用户轮次额外调用一次模型，把对话里的烦躁程度按 0–3 级判一次；级别高时只浮一句「先歇会儿或开个新对话」的提醒，不碰会话内容。可以摸头、喂饭、拖动，有 6 种运动模式、12 个互动动作、一个发送时才调用模型的迷你对话框，以及不调用模型的本地自动闲聊。情绪检查默认每 3 轮一次，设为 0 可关闭；检查和对话框回复都是真实模型调用，会消耗 token。

description.en: Live prices for a comma-separated list of A-share, Beijing, Hong Kong, or index codes under the DSH message composer, with red-up green-down colouring and session percentages.
description.zh: 在输入框下方用一行显示 A 股、北交所、港股或指数代码的实时价格，涨红跌绿并显示涨跌幅，多个代码可在右键菜单里配置并轮换。

description.en: Registers a skill for estimating short-term (1 week to 1 month) up/down scenario probabilities of a single stock and renders a four-scenario probability distribution chart with the A-share red-up/green-down convention; output is a structured subjective estimate based on weighted signals, not a statistical backtest.
description.zh: 注册一个技能，评估单只股票未来短周期（1周至1个月）的涨跌情景概率，并按 A 股红涨绿跌惯例输出四情景概率分布图；结果是基于信号加权的结构化主观估计，非统计回测。

description.en: Replaces the session header subagent list with a copy that shows model and reasoning effort, orders rows by state, adds status dots, token counts, working time and start time, and offers archive and two-click permanent delete of subagent sessions.
description.zh: 替换会话顶栏的子代理列表：显示模型与推理强度，按状态排序，加状态点、token 数、工作时长与开始时间，并支持归档与两次点击的永久删除子代理会话。

description.en: Attention-first, T3 Code-inspired inbox sidebar for DeepSeek Harness with Pinned, Active, Working, Snoozed, and Settled shelves, customizable snooze presets and calendar, ranked search, multi-select project filter, vertical sweep with 5-second undo, auto theme detection, 8-language UI, and one-click switch back to the native Workspaces sidebar.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 T3 Code 风格注意力收件箱侧边栏，支持置顶/待处理/运行中/已暂缓/已收尾分区、可编辑暂缓快捷选项与日历弹窗、高相关搜索、多选项目筛选、竖向扫选与 5 秒撤销、自动皮肤适配、8 语言界面，以及一键切回原生工作区视图。

description.en: Deliver a named role team into DeepSeek Harness: 19 role definitions, tools to spawn, message and list members, the native shared task board, handoff and checkpoint files, and a team-status panel plus a role button in the conversation page. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把一支具名角色团队交付进 DeepSeek Harness：19 个角色定义、派生/发消息/查名册的工具、原生共享任务板、交接与检查点落盘，以及对话页的「团队状态」面板与输入框那枚「角色」按钮。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Routes native DSH team delegations to authorized models using seven configurable task categories.
description.zh: 为 DSH 原生团队委派提供七种可配置的任务类别，按类别为新队友选择已授权的模型。

description.en: Tiles full native DSH Web conversations side by side, preserving each session's plugins and right sidebar, with saved pane widths and order and swipe navigation on mobile.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中并排平铺完整原生会话，保留各自的插件与右侧栏，可独立调宽、记住宽度与顺序，并在手机上滑动切换。

description.en: A transparent 3D aquarium in the DSH workbench: two fish species, three planted layouts, drag-to-rotate, wheel zoom and tap-to-startle, with fish food earned from token usage.
description.zh: DSH 工作台里的透明三维鱼缸：红绿灯与小丑鱼、三套生态造景，可拖动旋转、滚轮放大、单击玻璃惊鱼，鱼食用 Token 用量兑换。

description.en: Token usage panel: a sidebar card and a full dashboard with per-model input/output/cache bars, a 7-day total, and per-call billing that charges local models nothing and platform APIs at their official rates. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: Token 消耗面板：侧边栏小卡与完整面板，按模型展示输入、输出、缓存的堆叠条与近 7 天总量，并按官方价逐次计费（本地模型 $0，未定价模型显式标注）。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Sandbox materialization check and repair for DSH workspaces on Windows. Finds existing directories missing the three sandbox items — capability ACE, deny-delete-child, low integrity label; a first-message dialog and the plugin page each list the missing items, and only the entries you select are repaired after one UAC prompt. The plugin never changes ACLs on its own.
description.zh: DSH 工作区的沙箱物化体检与修复（Windows）。检查既有目录是否缺了沙箱所需的三项——能力 ACE、拒绝删除子项、低完整性标签；会话首条消息弹窗与插件配置页两条路径各自列出缺项，用户确认并过 UAC 后只补勾选项，插件从不自动改 ACL。

description.en: Play local video and audio inside the sidebar preview — HTTP Range streaming keeps memory flat at any file size, nothing buffers until you press play, playback pauses when the pane is hidden, and formats the browser cannot decode hand off to a native player.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏直接播放本地视频与音频：HTTP Range 流式读取让内存不随文件变大、不点播放不缓冲、侧边栏收起即暂停；浏览器解不了的格式一键交给本机播放器。

description.en: Opens the current session's working directory or a selected .code-workspace file in VS Code from the DeepSeek Harness session menu.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 会话菜单在 VS Code 中打开当前工作目录或选中的 .code-workspace 文件。

description.en: Show only the current workspace's sessions in the DSH sidebar, with a popup switcher, search, keyboard navigation, drag-to-reorder, and rename/delete.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏只显示当前工作区的会话，提供弹窗切换、搜索、键盘导航、拖拽排序与重命名/删除。

description.en: Serves the DSH Go workspace folder over FTP and WebDAV with a built-in browser panel, so a phone file manager such as MT Manager can mount it read-write.
description.zh: 内置面板一键开启 FTP 与 WebDAV，把 DSH Go 的工作区目录转发出去，MT 管理器等客户端可直接挂载读写。

description.en: Fast, encoding-safe Windows command runner for DSH: cmd.exe plus a native PowerShell subset, PowerShell-level permissions, and background jobs with a bounded ring buffer.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的快速、编码安全的 Windows 命令执行器：cmd.exe 加原生 PowerShell 子集，拥有 PowerShell 级权限，后台任务带环形缓冲。

description.en: Read-only monitoring for HGDB and PostgreSQL 14+, including live metrics, sessions, blocking chains, Top SQL, replication status, historical trends and eight DSH agent tools.
description.zh: 面向 HGDB 与 PostgreSQL 14+ 的只读监控插件，提供实时指标、会话与阻塞链、Top SQL、复制状态、历史趋势及八个 DSH 智能体工具。

description.en: Plan portrait shoots in DSH and import the ordered shot list into Muse Frame to review framing, lighting and wardrobe continuity.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中编排人像拍摄计划，逐镜确定取景、光线与服装连续性，再将镜头清单导入 Muse Frame 工作台。

description.en: Chat panel as a sidebar entry. A conversation view over a pinned DSH session, plus an outbound panel that relays QQ messages through a local OneBot implementation and drafts Bilibili comments for manual approval. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 侧栏一级入口的聊天面板。在固定的 DSH 会话上提供一套会话界面，另有对外分区：通过本地 OneBot 转发 QQ 消息，并为 B 站视频起草评论草稿、由你手动确认后才发。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: 小鱼缸 Tiny Tank — DSH 桌面里的透明三维鱼缸：鱼群、造景、敲击投喂与 Token 兑换鱼食
description.zh: DSH 桌面里养个透明 3D 鱼缸，能转能喂鱼，鱼食用 Token 用量兑换，干活更有趣。

description.en: Per-workspace settings for DeepSeek Harness: each workspace can set the default model its new sessions start from, and workspaces without one keep the deployment default.
description.zh: 给每个工作区保存各自的设置，目前提供默认模型：新会话按工作区设置启动，没设置的工作区沿用全局默认模型。

description.en: Host-side control plane for DeepSeek Harness: a read-only mother, workspace essences, disposable forked dsh-Web children on stock or accelerated cores, a global fork write red line, curated Vault export/import, a decision inbox, restart guard and audit ledger. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的宿主控制面：只读母体、元主、可丢弃的官方核/加速核分身，所有分身的全局写入红线，Vault 分类导出/导入，共享决策收件箱、重启守卫与审计账本。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Read and continue your MonkeyAI conversations inside DeepSeek Harness: browse session history and send new instructions to pick up where you left off in the MonkeyAI client
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接翻看 MonkeyAI 设备的会话记录、续聊发指令，还能随时停止和切换模型。
在 DSH 里统一管理 MCP 服务器，一键安装、启停和配置，让外部工具接入更省心。

description.en: Notepad — a per-workspace floating note window in the DeepSeek Harness session view: problems, next steps, one-click insert into the composer, drag, minimize, hide.
description.zh: 在会话界面放一张当前工作区的便签浮窗，随手记问题和下一步，一键插入对话框。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for the DSH Mobile Android app: QR pairing, DSH on your phone, answer approvals from notifications.
description.zh: 把 DSH 装进安卓手机，扫码配对后就能在通知栏里直接处理回答审批。
给会话加个回收站，当前会话一键移入，误删的能恢复，不要的也能彻底删掉。
